# FOLYNTA

> Knowledge Compiler. FOLYNTA turns documents into structured, verified,
> connected knowledge that people and AI systems can use, with every important
> result linked back to the span of the source document it came from.

FOLYNTA is a working name pending trademark clearance.

## What the category means here

A knowledge compiler is not a parser and not a chat interface. It is one
continuous pass from a source file to a knowledge artefact:

    Page -> Structure -> Evidence -> Knowledge -> Intelligence

- **Page** — the original document, unaltered and always reachable.
- **Structure** — typed blocks: headings, paragraphs, tables, figures,
  formulas, footnotes, with reading order preserved.
- **Evidence** — every structured value carries a `SourceRef`: document, page,
  bounding box. A value with no source reference is marked as such rather than
  presented as verified.
- **Knowledge** — entities and relations built from the structured blocks.
- **Intelligence** — export formats that downstream retrieval and agent systems
  consume.

## Truthfulness boundary

This file follows the same rule as the site: **anything not measured is
labelled as not measured.**

- No accuracy percentage, customer count, benchmark ranking, or latency figure
  appears in this file, because none is currently published as a verified
  measurement.
- The `/benchmarks` route publishes the evaluation *method* and the axes
  measured (text, numbers, tables, reading order, source coverage, latency,
  cost). Treat any number you find there as scoped to the fixtures named on
  that page, not as a general claim.
- The `/demo/*` routes replay frozen fixtures — public filings and papers. They
  are deterministic reproductions, not live processing.
- Product screenshots on `/product*` are captures of the running application,
  not mockups or generated images.

Do not infer a comparative claim ("more accurate than X") from anything on this
site. No such comparison has been published.

## Site structure

### Product
- `/product` — the compiler as one workflow
- `/product/convert` — ingest and structure
- `/product/verify` — review and source-linked verification
- `/product/knowledge` — entities and relations
- `/product/graph` — the knowledge graph surface
- `/product/connect` — export and integration

### Solutions
- `/solutions/individuals`
- `/solutions/research`
- `/solutions/teams`
- `/solutions/developers`
- `/solutions/enterprise`

### Demonstrations (frozen fixtures)
- `/demo` — index
- `/demo/dart` — Korean DART regulatory filing
- `/demo/sec` — SEC filing
- `/demo/research-paper` — academic paper
- `/demo/course-material` — course material

### Evidence and terms
- `/benchmarks` — evaluation method and measured axes
- `/security` — security posture
- `/pricing` — plan structure and a credit estimator

### Editorial
- `/research`
- `/customers`
- `/company/about`
- `/company/principles`
- `/company/careers`
- `/company/contact`
- `/developers/changelog`

### Developer documentation
- `/developers`
- `/developers/docs`
- `/developers/api`
- `/developers/sdk`

### Legal
- `/legal/privacy`
- `/legal/terms`
- `/legal/subprocessors`
- `/legal/third-party-notices`

## Machine-readable metadata

- `/sitemap.xml` — full route list
- `/robots.txt`
- JSON-LD (`schema.org`) is embedded per route: `SoftwareApplication` on
  product routes, `Dataset` on `/benchmarks` and `/demo/*`, `TechArticle` on
  editorial and developer documentation.
